brief: Backlog triage after JS-166 closed on D-065: criterion 7's docs/running.md part and criterion 8's 100-segment store measurement were not taken; the 93% throttling reading was not kept; several parts were not re-measured after the sizing correction; two worker starts on the 4-core node claimed at 37 and 58 s, unexplained; the evidence is one film, one cluster, one worker with no helper.
tradeoff: Given up: a kept measurement of the time from a worker storing a segment to another node's stream replica serving it on a shared S3 store, and a cause for the two slow worker starts. Given up by the dogfood's operator and household, as under D-065: a fault in those is found by use, not a staged run. No viewer or operator loses a capability; operators get the running-workers-apart guidance with JS-056 and JS-177, not sooner.
entry: No new task, no priority moved, no dogfood run. Criterion 7's docs part is carried by JS-056 criteria 10 and 11 and JS-177's 'Sizing workers' (note on JS-056). Criterion 8 is BL-263, promoted on a segment wait over 5 s with the encode at or above 1.0x across nodes, an operator report of a slower store, or JS-062 starting. The unmeasured parts are one item, BL-261, its triggers unchanged. The slow worker starts are a note on JS-057 criterion 2, which records a start in its parts. The 93% reading is marked not kept on JS-177 and decides nothing. BL-245 and BL-253 are re-pointed from JS-166 criterion 9 to JS-177's logged moves; BL-254 loses its JS-166 clause; BL-248 and BL-243 gain JS-166's figures and stay. Reopens on: BL-261's or BL-263's triggers; an operator report of separate-machine roles failing on the store (the docs paragraph then moves ahead, docs only); a viewer refused or timed out in the queue more than 10 s after a worker pod is ready.
serves: Owner, 2026-11-22: 'Work that makes an existing capability more certain does not keep going ahead of a missing capability viewers would feel more, unless measured data shows that capability failing viewers now.' PRODUCT.md: 'Installing is boring'; 'Growing is adding machines'; 'Where a capability can't yet serve every film, the gap is written down and planned, not left as a quirk.' D-065.
